data.title: Efficient Code Embeddings from Code Generation Models
data.description: arXiv:2508.21290v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: jina-code-embeddings is a novel code embedding model suite designed to retrieve code from natural language queries, perform technical question-answering, and identify semantically similar code snippets across programming languages. It makes innovative use of an autoregressive backbone pre-trained on both text and code, generating embeddings via last-token pooling. We outline the training recipe and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance despite the relatively small size of the models, validating this approach to code embedding model construction.
data.author: Daria Kryvosheieva, Saba Sturua, Michael G\"unther, Han Xiao
